items.text: For each local revoke completion and remote 4003 independently, start revocation on A, hold the notification, pair B to the same host, then deliver A's notification. B's credential, list entry, open page and connection survive. Restart the same installation and actually reconnect B.

Deliver the two signals twice and in either order, including 4003 before the local response. Deduplication, notices and forgotten-host state are enrollment-scoped. An already deleted key is success; a transient read or deletion failure leaves recoverable intent.
Stop after committing intent and again after deleting the credential but before clearing intent. Startup retries exactly the old enrollment and clears finished work. Another host remains connectable.

Revoke from the host detail and device management entries. PairingUITests, PairAgainUITests and RevokeUITests retain their expected pairing, success and dismissal behavior through the applicable demos.
